group.title: Flume's command line and the facts read from it

agent.last_words: zsh didn't split the words, which happened to capture Flume's exit-2 usage refusal; keeping that one and running the acts properly.

tasks.text: 1.1 The configuration reads `repository_root` and `fetch_interval`, refuses `views` and `fetch_every` naming the key that holds each now, and refuses a key naming a stream or a kind saying it is Flume's host configuration; `Config`, `run.rs`, every test, README and CLAUDE.md take the new names, and the start line names the repository root (design Decision 3; core.5, core.12; configuration spec: "The configuration names each repository by its forge address", "The repository root is a setting with a default", "How often repositories are fetched is a setting with a default" and "The configuration holds nothing the runner does not read"; running spec: "flywheel run keeps the repositories until it is stopped" and "The runner says what it does, one line each"; views spec: "Each kept repository has one view under the repository root", "A view moves with the repository root", "An old view that is gone holds nothing back" and "A removed view takes its owner's folder only when that is empty"; clones spec "Each kept repository has one bare clone in the runner's data directory"; Task notes 1.1). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test root:format` passes with a test per scenario of the configuration spec's modified requirements.
1.2 Run this group's checks. True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:format flywheel:lint flywheel:typecheck flywheel:test root:format root:specs root:changes` passes.

2.1 `crates/flywheel-control` is a library crate in the cargo workspace's `members`, and a moon project `flywheel-control` in `.moon/workspace.yml` with its language declared as rust. Its check-fast tasks, format, lint, typecheck and test, are one task per check, each declaring its inputs with `/devenv.nix`, `/devenv.lock` and `/.prototools` among them (design Decision 1; core.7; Task notes 2.1). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-control:format flywheel-control:lint flywheel-control:typecheck flywheel-control:test` passes.

2.2 The `ControlPlane` trait with its pull and report exists as design Decision 2 has it, with the types of the hello, the wants, the leases, the launch, the terminals and the runner's report, each named as its table has it. The report round-trips as JSON, and a carried text's time and an answer's time move only when their text does (Task notes 2.2). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-control:test` passes with a round-trip test of each type and the tests of `Report::answer` and `Report::carry`.

2.3 The fake control plane holds the wants and terminals a test sets, refuses a pull or a report when told, gives back the last report, and lets go and refuses what a test names. The shared cases run against it (control-plane-interface spec: "A pull gives what the control plane wants, in its order", "Work carries the control plane's ids and leases", "A launch names what Flume is to be given", "The runner's report is reported whole", "A report's answer names what is let go and what is refused" and "Every implementation passes the shared cases", its scenario "The fake control plane passes"; Task notes 2.3). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-control:test` passes with the shared cases run against `Fake`.
2.4 Run this group's checks. True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-control:format flywheel-control:lint flywheel-control:typecheck flywheel-control:test` passes.

3.1 `crates/flywheel/src/flume.rs` runs Flume's command line as design Decision 9 has it: `--kind` as the launch gives it and never `--kinds`, every other launch flag only where the launch gives it, `--json` first, `FLUME_RECIPIENT` unset, the brief's file removed once Flume answers, and each answer read by Flume's exit. Fixtures of Flume's own answers are captured into `crates/flywheel/tests/fixtures/flume-<version>/` with a README saying where, when and from what each was read. `treefmt.nix` excludes them by name, with its reason (core.5, core.7; Task notes 3.1). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test root:format` passes with the stub tests of Task notes 3.1.

3.2 `crates/flywheel/src/facts.rs` reads each fact of design Decisions 6, 8, 12, 13 and 16 from Flume's status, each guarded so that a field absent or of another type reads as none. It slices a place's entry and the host part's fields as Flume printed them (Task notes 3.2). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test over every fixture of 3.1.
3.3 Run this group's checks. True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:format flywheel:lint flywheel:typecheck flywheel:test root:format` passes.

4.1 The control pass of design Decision 5 runs over a control plane, Flume and the clones, with the runner's report file and the hello of Decision 6. Offers are taken, left or refused for their repository and clone as Decision 7's steps 1 to 4 have it, and launched and answered as Decision 9 has it. `crates/flywheel` depends on `flywheel-control`, and its moon tasks take that crate's sources as inputs (work-into-flume spec: "Every pull carries the host's tools, repositories and leases", "Every pull carries Flume's host part as Flume printed it", "An offer is taken only for a repository the runner keeps", "A launch is one `flume launch` naming what the launch gives", "A launch's kind is passed as the launch gives it, and no kinds file", "Flume runs with no recipient of the runner's own, and no brief is left" and "Every answer is Flume's"; control-plane-interface spec: the scenarios "A pull that cannot be read", "An offer's lease kept with its answer" and "A report not sent"; Task notes 4.1). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per scenario named.

4.2 A launch is made only while its stream has room, counted down within a pass, as design Decision 8 has it (work-into-flume spec: "Room is read from Flume's status and counted down within a pass" and "A launch is made only while the stream it runs in has room"; Task notes 4.2). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per scenario of those requirements.

4.3 An offer waits for each launch it comes after, with held words, and an act on a launch not yet launched is answered from the report, as design Decisions 7 and 9 have it (work-into-flume spec: "An offer waits for each launch it comes after", "A priority or a drop of a launch not yet launched is answered from its report" and "A retry or a done of a launch not launched, and an act on another's launch, are refused"; Task notes 4.3). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per scenario of those requirements.

4.4 Each launch, act and command is carried out once: the report is saved by rename after each, read at start and taken from the control plane where missing, and a launch is found by its mark (design Decision 11; work-into-flume spec "Each launch, act and command is carried out once"; Task notes 4.4). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per scenario of that requirement and the third case of Task notes 4.4.

4.5 A retry, drop, priority and done are Flume's own commands on the launch's place, never forced (design Decision 9; work-into-flume spec "A retry, a drop, a priority and a done are Flume's own commands on the launch's place"; Task notes 4.5). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per act and one of a refusal.

4.6 Every report names each lease with its work, the control pass is due before a lease lapses, and a launch whose report is refused is let go and its place left (design Decision 11; core.10; work-into-flume spec "A lease is renewed by every report and let go once refused"; Task notes 4.6). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per scenario of that requirement and the timing function's unit test.

4.7 Flume's status of each place is carried as Flume gave it, read again only when its entry changes, and a landing is told once. The runner acts only on its own places, and says each act in one line (design Decisions 5 and 12; work-into-flume spec: "Flume's status of each place is carried as Flume gave it", "A place the listing no longer holds keeps its last status", "A landing is told to the keeper once", "The runner acts only on its own places" and "The runner says each act, one line each"; Task notes 4.7). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per scenario of those requirements.
4.8 Run this group's checks. True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:format flywheel:lint flywheel:typecheck flywheel:test` passes.

5.1 `crates/flywheel/src/sluice.rs` reads each submission Flume names by `sluice status <id> --json` in the clone, and the pass carries the fields of design Decision 13, each as sluice printed it, with no row's `log` (core.11; tool-records spec: "Each submission Flume names is carried from sluice's own answer", "No log of sluice's is carried" and "An entry is read until it is final"; Task notes 5.1). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per scenario of those requirements.

5.2 `crates/flywheel/src/inbox.rs` carries each inbox the control plane names at each new tip of its branch, as design Decision 14 has it, through git and weir-signals at the revision flume pins, each item's brief by its digest (tool-records spec: "An inbox is read at each new tip of its branch", "An inbox's records are carried as references", "An inbox weir refuses keeps what was carried" and "An inbox is carried only from a repository the runner keeps"; Task notes 5.2). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per scenario of those requirements.
5.3 Run this group's checks. True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:format flywheel:lint flywheel:typecheck flywheel:test` passes.

6.1 A branch command is carried out by `sluice branch create` in the clone, once, with sluice's answer carried as given and the origin commit read from origin. A command for a repository not kept is refused, one whose clone is not made is left untaken, and a command of another sort is refused (design Decision 15; branch-commands spec, every requirement; Task notes 6.1). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per scenario of the branch-commands spec.
6.2 Run this group's checks. True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:format flywheel:lint flywheel:typecheck flywheel:test` passes.

7.1 `crates/flywheel/src/terminal.rs` relays a terminal on a launch held, through herdr's command line, to the pane Flume's status names, on a thread of its own. It closes with its link, its pane or its launch, and keeps nothing (design Decision 16; core.11; terminal-relay spec, every requirement; Task notes 7.1). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per scenario of the terminal-relay spec.
7.2 Run this group's checks. True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:format flywheel:lint flywheel:typecheck flywheel:test` passes.

8.1 `crates/flywheel-crew` is a library crate in the cargo workspace's `members`, and a moon project `flywheel-crew` in `.moon/workspace.yml` with its language declared as rust. Its check-fast tasks are one task per check, each declaring its inputs with `/devenv.nix`, `/devenv.lock`, `/.prototools` and `/crates/flywheel-control/**/*` among them. `devenv.nix` pins recutils by version, asserted as git is, and `check-toolchain.sh` checks `recfix --version` against it (core.7, core.8; Task notes 8.1). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-crew:format flywheel-crew:lint flywheel-crew:typecheck flywheel-crew:test root:toolchain root:format` passes, and `root:toolchain` says recutils' version.

8.2 crew's table is read as design Decision 4 has it, `host` and `partitions` with each `label` and `state_repository`, each refusal naming its key, and `kinds` refused saying kinds are Flume's (crew-control-plane spec: "crew's table names the host and the partitions" and "A state repository is reached through the host's own credential helper"; Task notes 8.2). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-crew:test` passes with a test per scenario of those requirements and each case of Task notes 8.2.

8.3 crew's records are read at one tip of each partition's `<label>/main`, and each request naming this host is given as an offer or an act under the lease number 1 (design Decision 17; crew-control-plane spec: "crew's records are read at one tip of each partition's flywheel branch", "A partition that cannot be read hides only its own work", "Each request for this host is a want under the lease number 1", "A launch request is an offer of what it names", "A retry, a drop and a priority are acts on the launch they name" and "A request crew's implementation cannot read is refused by its host's runner"; Task notes 8.3). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-crew:test` passes with a test per scenario of those requirements.

8.4 The runner's branch is written in crew's formats, with crew's descriptors byte for byte, and no other ref is pushed (design Decision 17; crew-control-plane spec: "The runner's branch is written by weir's write, and only it is pushed" and "The runner's branch holds crew's three files in crew's formats"; Task notes 8.4). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-crew:test` passes with a test per scenario of those requirements and each case of Task notes 8.4.

8.5 A launch naming no host is given only where this runner keeps its repository, claimed on the runner's own branch while the host has room, given only once no other runner's branch answers it, and withdrawn otherwise; an act naming no host goes to the runner holding its launch (design Decision 18; crew-control-plane spec: "A launch naming no host is given only where this runner keeps its repository", "A launch naming no host is claimed before it is given", "A launch naming no host is claimed only while the host has room", "A claim stands until the runner answers its launch", "A withdrawn launch is claimed again in the name order of its claimants" and "An act naming no host is given to the runner that holds its launch"; Task notes 8.5). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-crew:test` passes with a test per scenario of those requirements and each case of Task notes 8.5.

8.6 Each role of this host is offered while crew's records want it and no run stands, its kind the identity `<Kinds>/<Kind>`, and its run is declared done once its turn has delivered, as crew's `asks.py` reads them (design Decisions 10 and 19; crew-control-plane spec: "A role is wanted while anything is pending for it", "A place waits on a role as crew reads it", "A role's run is offered while it is wanted and none stands" and "A role's run is declared done once its turn has delivered"; Task notes 8.6). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-crew:test` passes with a test per scenario of those requirements and each case of Task notes 8.6.

8.7 A launch is let go once its work has left crew's plan (design Decision 17; crew-control-plane spec "A launch is let go once its work has left crew's plan"; Task notes 8.7). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-crew:test` passes with a test per scenario of that requirement and each case of Task notes 8.7.

8.8 crew's implementation passes `flywheel-control`'s shared cases (control-plane-interface spec, the scenario "crew's implementation passes"; Task notes 8.8). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-crew:test` passes with the shared cases run against a bare state repository.
8.9 Run this group's checks. True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-crew:format flywheel-crew:lint flywheel-crew:typecheck flywheel-crew:test root:toolchain root:format` passes.

9.1 `crates/flywheel/src/planes.rs` lists `crew` and its opener. The configuration reads `[control_plane]`, its `type` and `poll_interval`. The loop makes control passes on their own timer and when woken, and `--once` makes one of each. `crates/flywheel` depends on `flywheel-crew`, and its moon tasks take that crate's sources as inputs (design Decisions 1, 4 and 5; configuration spec: "The configuration may name the control plane", "How often the control plane is polled is a setting with a default" and "The control-plane table is read when the runner starts"; running spec: "flywheel run --once makes one pass", "flywheel run makes control passes on a timer of their own", "A control pass runs at once when its control plane wakes the runner" and "A control pass after a broken configuration acts on nothing"; control-plane-interface spec "The configuration chooses the implementation"; Task notes 9.1). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with a test per scenario of those requirements.

9.2 `crates/flywheel/tests/rules.rs` holds core.2 and core.7 over the tree, and the no-listener test reads every crate's sources (control-plane-interface spec "The control plane is reached through one interface"; Task notes 9.2). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with those tests.

9.3 One control pass end to end, with crew's implementation over a bare state repository, a stub `flume` and the sibling's clones, claims two kit launches naming no host, answers the first launched and holds its dependent, then launches the dependent once the first has landed (design Decisions 5, 7, 9, 17 and 18; Task notes 9.3). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with `tests/pass.rs`.

9.4 README says what the runner carries, with the `[control_plane]` table of design Decision 4 in a fenced `toml` block, the runner's branch, and that kinds and streams are Flume's host configuration. CLAUDE.md's opening paragraph says what the crate now does, and a test opens crew's implementation from README's block (Task notes 9.4). True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:test` passes with the README test.
9.5 Run this group's checks. True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel:format flywheel:lint flywheel:typecheck flywheel:test` passes.

10.1 Run the checks of the moon projects this change touches. True when `devenv shell -- moon run flywheel-control:format flywheel-control:lint flywheel-control:typecheck flywheel-control:test flywheel-crew:format flywheel-crew:lint flywheel-crew:typecheck flywheel-crew:test flywheel:format flywheel:lint flywheel:typecheck flywheel:test root:format root:toolchain root:adrs root:specs root:changes` passes.
